holds: exam-mate: reverse-engineering research + runbooks + full question harvest (questions.jsonl + meta.json for 132 subjects, 88,323 questions; source-of-record for questions)

syllabai-experimental.notes: Local checkout at local_path is SPARSE-CHECKED OUT: the big images/ trees are NOT materialized on disk (they live on GitHub). Do not re-run image downloads against this repo.

holds: ALL exam-mate image downloads from 2026-10-22 onward (~100k image URLs outstanding at split time)
fresh re-imaging of the two ledger-only subjects (4BI0, 9701)
split-storage image-phase tooling (canonical for images from now on)

storage_policy.questions: source-of-record stays in syllabai-experimental (questions.jsonl, meta.json, catalog.json, subject_taxonomy.json)
storage_policy.images_from_2026-10-22: download into syllabai-experimental-2 under exam-mate/resources/topical_papers/topical/... (same subject-dir layout as the sister repo)

storage_policy.image_fetch_auth: anonymous + unmetered (question-LIST serving is metered; images are not) — no exam-mate login needed for the image phase
storage_policy.commit_cadence: git add + commit + push after every finished subject; monitor df -h /
